brief:
Hamas warned Wednesday that Israeli forces are using photos of senior captive Ibrahim Hamad during field interrogations with Palestinians, describing the practice as intimidation targeting prisoners and their families, Shehab Wire reported. The movement characterized the tactic as a direct threat to detainees held in Israeli custody.

Hamas did not elaborate on where or when the interrogations occurred or provide additional specifics about the alleged practice.
